contents: This is an open-source project—pull requests are welcome!
Join our Discord community to report issues, share feedback, and keep track of the latest project updates.
Card data is pulled from the Official Hololive OCG (JP) site and auto-translated into 7 languages via LLM 🤖
disclaimer: This wiki is a fan-made, non-official project. All content is created by the community and follows Cover Corp.'s Derivative Works Guidelines.
